A '''Covenant identichip''' was a small [[Identichip/Legends|identichip]] containing a small amount of information for easy access. The [[Jedi Covenant]] used a type of microtag to organize information about [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] stored in the [[Sanctum of the Exalted]] on [[Odryn]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 29">[[Knights of the Old Republic 29|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 29]]</ref>
